info.title: GSharp interactive REPL
info.description: Interactive REPL (`gsi`) for the GSharp language. Requires a .NET 10 runtime.

options.name: --engine
options.description:
Interactive engine: 'emit' (the default and only
engine; also via GSI_ENGINE). The legacy 'evaluator'
engine was removed in ADR-0156 Phase 3c.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show the gsi version and exit.
(no args)              Start the interactive REPL.
